headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool, Bayern battle for Gladbach teen Wael Mohya
description: Liverpool and Bayern Munich are interested in Borussia Mönchengladbach attacking midfielder Wael Mohya. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Reranking the MVP for each of the top Premier League clubs
description: Based on a simple combination of ability and tactical importance, we've reranked the best players in order at the top Premier League clubs.

headline: Mauricio Pochettino's first day at Man United: 'You will see, give me time'
description: Mauricio Pochettino will arrive at Manchester United for his first day as their head coach on Wednesday but said he requires "time" to turn their fortunes around.

headline: JJ Gabriel confirms Man United exit as Real Madrid transfer nears
description: JJ Gabriel has confirmed his departure from Manchester United in a post on Instagram and thanked the club for the role they have played in his career.

headline: Matheus Nunes in talks to extend Man City deal - sources
description: Manchester City are in talks with Matheus Nunes about extending his contract at the Etihad Stadium, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Thomas Frank: Crystal Palace job 'too good' to turn down
description: Thomas Frank decided the Crystal Palace job was "too good to turn down" after talks with chairman Steve Parish.
